channel.title: Data & Schema Design on The Art of PostgreSQL
channel.description: Recent content in Data & Schema Design on The Art of PostgreSQL

item.title: Foreign Key Constraints and What the Planner Knows
item.description: A foreign key is not just validation — it is a declaration that tells the query planner something is guaranteed, enabling optimizations it cannot safely make without that guarantee.

item.title: JSONB and Arrays
item.description: PostgreSQL’s JSONB and array types let you store semi-structured data without leaving the relational model — and without sacrificing indexability or query power.

item.title: Range Types and Temporal Constraints
item.description: PostgreSQL range types represent intervals with operators for overlap, containment, and adjacency — and pair with GiST exclusion constraints to enforce non-overlap at write time.
